Package io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.model

Class ParameterModel

java.lang.Object
io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.model.ParameterModel
public class ParameterModel extends Object
Model representing a command method parameter.

All annotation-derived facts are resolved once at parse time: the resolver declared by @Resolve and the suggestion provider declared by @Suggest are linked here, so code generation never re-reads annotations from the parameter element.

  • Constructor Details

    • ParameterModel

      public ParameterModel(String name, TypeMirror type, boolean greedy, boolean optional, String defaultValue, String suggestProvider, String resolveName, MethodModel resolverMethod, MethodModel suggestMethod, VariableElement element)
      Constructs a ParameterModel.
      Parameters:
      name - the parameter name (from @Name or reflection)
      type - the Java type of the parameter
      greedy - true if marked with @Greedy
      optional - true if marked with @Default
      defaultValue - the default value string when optional, or null
      suggestProvider - the custom suggest provider name, or null
      resolveName - the raw @Resolve value, null when @Resolve is absent and empty when it is present without a resolver name
      resolverMethod - the resolver method model referenced by a named @Resolve, or null
      suggestMethod - the suggest provider method model when @Suggest names a valid method, or null when absent, a field, or an invalid signature
      element - the underlying VariableElement
